$comment: DEVLADLOG Microsoft 365 #5 - Microsoft Purview as code. Fictional tenant (contoso). For the lab, copy to compliance.lab.json (uncommitted) and replace contoso.onmicrosoft.com in labelPolicy.publishTo.

sensitivityLabels.name: Contoso-Public
sensitivityLabels.tooltip: Approved for anyone, inside or outside Contoso.

sensitivityLabels.name: Contoso-General
sensitivityLabels.tooltip: Day-to-day business data. Not for public release.

sensitivityLabels.name: Contoso-Confidential
sensitivityLabels.tooltip: Sensitive business data. Never share outside Contoso without approval.

labelPolicy.name: Contoso labels - pilot
labelPolicy.comment: Pilot group first; widen after feedback.

dlpPolicies.name: Contoso - Card numbers
dlpPolicies.comment: Same shape as the PCI DSS template: notify on a few, block external sharing of many.

rules.name: Card numbers - low count
rules.policyTip: This contains card numbers. Remove them before sharing outside Contoso.

rules.name: Card numbers - high count
rules.policyTip: Blocked: 10 or more card numbers can't leave Contoso. Override only with a business justification.

dlpPolicies.name: Contoso - Confidential label
dlpPolicies.comment: Sensitivity label as a condition: not supported for Teams chat, so this policy leaves Teams out.

rules.name: Confidential - external
rules.policyTip: Confidential content can't be shared outside Contoso.

labels.name: Contoso Contract - 7 years
labels.comment: Keep 7 years from creation, then delete.

labelPolicy.name: Contoso retention labels
labelPolicy.comment: Publishes the contract label to mailboxes, SharePoint and OneDrive (one label per policy: one rule per retention policy).
labelPolicy.label: Contoso Contract - 7 years
